description: This sporeglider derived its striking hue from the unique fungus growing around Teldrassil's roots.

name: Steel Prototype Panther MK-0
description: The first Steel Horde soldiers crossing the Dark Portal captured a ferocious nightsaber. Blackrock artisans armed it with magma armor, transforming it into a combat weapon. Warriors may customize its parts at the Morphing Forum to suit their fighting style and dominate the battlefield.

name: Starspark Netherdrake
description: After flying you to the ends of Outland and beyond, the netherwing drake was eventually drawn to the blue skies of Azeroth as well.

name: Felscorned Vilebrood Vanquisher
description: This flying amalgamation of the forces of death and fel pierces the skies with a bone-chilling screech.

name: Slayer's Felscorned Shrieker
description: Torn from the heavens by only the most cunning of Demon Hunters.

name: Felscorned Wolfhawk
description: Scarred by the war across the Broken Isles, this Wolfhawk deserves a good home.

name: Archmage's Felscorned Disc
description: Some mages say fel magics are "volatile" or "corruptive" or "forbidden". Some mages are wrong.

name: Felscorned Grandmaster's Companion
description: A twisted visage of a beloved companion.

name: Felscorned Highlord's Charger
description: This horse has been irreversibly scarred by the Legion's corrupt magics.

name: High Priest's Felscorned Seeker
description: This fel-infused feathered friend flaps its wings at a frenetic pace to remain far above the frenzy below.

name: Shadowblade's Felscorned Omen
description: Your enemies will know fear before their end.

name: Farseer's Felscorned Tempest
description: Fel flavored fury.

name: Felscorned Netherlord's Dreadsteed
description: Simply oozing with potential.

name: Felscorned War Wyrm
description: The heavens tremble in anticipation of your arrival.

name: Cobalt Phase-Hunter
description: Due to the otherworldly energies that irradiated Draenor, these creatures can shift through space at will. As such, they are rarely seen... until it is too late.

name: Calamitous Carrion
description: Bearing Zul'Aman's fiercest riders, its shadowed wings strike down any who dare resist.

name: Convalescent Carrion
description: Circling above the dying and the doomed, its wings herald plague, ruin, and the certainty that nothing left in its shadow will rise again.

name: Thunderhoof Celestial
description: After the Thunder King's fall, his lingering thunder merged with the spirit of a white dragon. It strides on azure lightning, clouds swirling in its wake-where tyranny once reigned, now guardian light remains.

name: Stormgilded Celestial
description: Gilded in thunder, chosen by destiny. Golden lightning wraps its hooves, piercing the sky like tearing through night. Legends tie it closely to Emperor Shaohao.

name: Untainted Grove Crawler
description: Somehow this grove crawler remains untouched by the horrors that overran Fungara Village.

name: Echo of Aln'sharan
description: Heed well the song of the Goddess.

name: Augmented Stormray
description: Captured from K'aresh and mutated by Charonus, this stormray escaped from Voidscar Arena and has wandered the Voidstorm.

name: Fiery Dragonhawk
description: A dragonhawk whose wings shine as brightly as the leaves of its Eversong home.

name: Peridot Dragonhawk
description: Peridot dragonhawks are only awarded to those who have performed great deeds in service of Silvermoon.

name: Umbral Dragonhawk
description: Cloaked in blackened tones, this Dragonhawk glides with calm precision, its somber coloring lending it an air of quiet distinction.

name: Crimson Dragonhawk
description: A strikingly colored Dragonhawk admired across Quel'Thalas, its vivid red wings cutting bright arcs through the skies as it glides with smooth, effortless grace.

name: Cobalt Dragonhawk
description: A rare breed of Dragonhawk that soars the Thalassian skies on azure wings after having escaped from the Sunwing Rookery.

name: Amani Sharptalon
description: A rare variety of the Amani eagle, Sharptalons strike with terrifying precision and fly with unparalleled grace.

name: Crimson Silvermoon Hawkstrider
description: The pride of the Silvermoon Court, these hawkstriders are prized for their vibrant red plumage and purebred elegance.

name: Cerulean Hawkstrider
description: A brilliant-plumed hawkstrider that escaped from the Silvermoon stables, who knows where in Eversong it may be hiding?

name: Duskbrute Harrower
description: These harrowers are attracted to the constant battle cries and bloodshed across Slayer's Rise.

name: Contained Stormarion Defender
description: While often aggressive, some Harrowers can be tamed and taught to aid in defensive military techniques. This Harrower looks over the Stormarion Core to ensure none can breach it.

name: Preyseeker's Hubris
description: Larger mana wyrms are sometimes used as mounts by Blood Elves, but are more frequently kept as status symbols.

name: Preyseeker's Wrath
description: Mana wyrms that are large and strong enough to support full barding and rider are quite rare and highly prized.

name: Preyseeker's Nightmare
description: Golden mana wyrms are an uncommon mutation. Some of Astalor's side experiments have included efforts to increase their population..

name: Blessed Amani Burrower
description: A creature blessed by the wilds, it moves with the steadfast spirit and gentle strength the Amani hold sacred.

name: Giganto Manis
description: Whispers tell of the Giganto Manis, a titanic creature said to dwell within Azeroth's very veins. Those who claim to have seen it speak of claws vast enough to pierce a dragon's heart, and sharp enough to carve through the finest armor forged by mortal hands.

name: Witherbark Pango
description: This rather rambunctious Pango escaped from the Witherbark Tribe after having its armor affixed. Finders keepers!

name: Amani Blessed Bear
description: Once symbols of conquest, these war-bears now stride again, reborn through Nalorakk's blessing and the renewed spirit of the Amani.

name: Ancestral War Bear
description: Its tread resounds with the memory of ancient warriors, a living symbol of the unwavering ferocity the Amani revere.

name: Witherbark Warbear Mother
description: This warbear mother was captured by the Twilight's Blade while protecting her cub. Her continued separation from her cub is only angering her more. Anyone who manages to reunite her with her cub will have her eternal loyalty.

name: Relinquished Scarlet Charger
description: No longer a tool of the Scarlet Crusade, this charger now guides recruits down the path of the Light with renewed purpose.

name: Hexed Vilefeather Eagle
description: Once a proud sky-hunter, she now soars on withered wings, her spirit twisted by lingering necromantic curses that seep through every rotting plume and ghostlit eye.

name: Ravenous Shredclaw
description: Fast and dependable, Shredclaws were one of the first creatures tamed in the Voidstorm. Their owners learned quickly not to leave them alone with their pets.

name: Insatiable Shredclaw
description: The shredclaw has fully embraced the way of the Void: never satisfied, constantly seeking out new strength to dominate and new prey to devour.

name: Prowling Shredclaw
description: According to ren'dorei scouts, shredclaws are often seen hunting in packs.

name: Frenzied Shredclaw
description: Once a pack member dies, these shredclaws enter a frenzy of rage that not even a hulking ultradon can stop.

name: Vicious Snaplizard
description: These creatures are found sneaking through the battlefield and climbing over obstactles, ready to cause trouble for the Alliance.

name: Vicious Snaplizard
description: These creatures are found sneaking through the battlefield and climbing over obstactles, ready to cause trouble for the Horde.

name: Bronze Wilderling
description: The regal wilderlings twist through the sky, free as the unbound magic that sustains their flight.

name: Bronze Aquilon
description: The reliable steeds of Bastion are designed to mirror the proud and noble warriors of the Ascended.

name: Bronze Corpsefly
description: It takes a great deal of effort to decorate a corpsefly, but some would say the efforts are worth it.

name: Bronze Gravewing
description: While dark and ominous is the preferred aesthetic of those who reside in Revendreth, there are some who still favor gleaming luster.

name: Galactic Gladiator's Goredrake
description: Originating from the void, fully armored and ready for combat.

name: Geargrinder Mk. 11
description: Undergoes a new iteration each time it explodes!

name: Skypaw Glimmerfur
description: A Glimmerfur's coat takes on properties of its environment much like a camouflage. Patterns of bright blue skies and majestic white clouds have earned this glimmerfur the nickname "Skypaw."

name: Crimson Lupine
description: Once, the First Ones desired creations with fierce devotion they could mold to their purposes. The lupine of Zerith Mortis are one of their many creations, and those bearing crimson forms are said to be the most powerful of all.

name: Spectral Hawkstrider
description: Phalanx Breaker of the Silvermoon Cavalry, this companion of the past ever wills its rider forward.

name: Spawn of Vyranoth
description: Vyranoth's brood was decimated by the aspects, yet Vyranoth's actions have brought many of her surviving progeny to follow in her frigid path and aid in Azeroth's defense.

name: Brawlin' Bruno
description: Said to be leaner and potentially even meaner than the venerable Bruce. Bruno's legacy is yet to be written.

name: Ballistic Bronco
description: Ideal transportation for a Brawler that always hits their mark.

name: Snowpaw Glimmerfur Prowler
description: The snowpaw inhabit the frigid afterlives of the Shadowlands, reveling in their frosty environment. Travelers thought lost to the deadly blizzards of Northrend would sometimes miraculously be found alive, proclaiming that they owe their lives to the mysterious foxes that protected them.

name: Lucent Hawkstrider
description: A loyal creature of Thalassian nobility, it finds comfort holed up in the Magisters' Terrace.

name: Emerald Hawkstrider
description: Its rider died during battle, and so the saddle is passed to you.

name: Venomous Gladiator's Goredrake
description: This armored mount makes everyone around you green with envy.

name: Savage Crimson Battle Turtle
description: This savage turtle sees red at every turn. Though slow in speed, it is vital to remember that nothing can outrun a cannon.

name: Cloudborn Razorwing
description: A very rare Korthian creature, due to limited cloud cover.

name: Sanguine Harrower
description: A brutal aerial predator of the Voidstorm, the Sanguine Harrower makes up for its lack of stealth with a terrifying visage and hunting prowess.

name: Voidbound Stormray
description: With its razor-sharp teeth, the Voidbound Stormray look eager to bite you. It will, but only if you let it.

name: Lab-Grown Stormray
description: Through the intensive research in the Void, researchers were able to bring this stormray back to life completely tamed.

name: Tenebrous Harrower
description: The fiercest harrowers of Voidstorm are often twisted by the void and bound to Xal'atath's will.

name: The Sire's Palanquin
description: This mount is so comfortable that you will sleep like the dead while riding it.

name: Arboreal Pseudoshell
description: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

name: Cabbage Pseudoshell
description: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

name: Lavender Pseudoshell
description: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

name: Accented Pseudoshell
description: The plants of the deep lands often emulate the creatures of of Azeroth. The purpose of the mimicry is unknown, but can be quite disturbing when the terrestrial mollusks are on the wrong end of an arboreal meal.

name: Fantastical Goblin Waveshredder
description: When you're ready for fun you're ready for the Fantastical Goblin Waveshredder. Guaranteed to bring the fun. *Disclaimer: Fun not guaranteed

name: Delver's Arcane Golem
description: Originally intended as a gift for Silvermoon, this construct was lost in transit near the shores of Gnarldor Isle.

name: Silvermoon's Arcane Defender
description: A gilded variant of the Arcane Guardian, most often seen guarding the more opulent districts of Silvermoon City.

name: Elven Arcane Guardian
description: Sworn defender of the Elven people, animated by arcane power and an unyielding will to protect.

name: Arcanovoid Construct
description: The Void's influence is far-reaching and overpowering enough that even an Arcane Guardian can be made to kneel.

name: Ghastropod
description: This snail make a deliberate decision to plunge itself into the slime canals of Undercity. It emerged bigger, stronger but not faster than before.

name: Vicious Snapvine
description: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. This Snapvine is always wanting to see more of the world and be fed.

name: Ferocious Snapvine
description: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. The fruit from this beast is especially delicious when baked in a pie.

name: Blooded Snapvine
description: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. The distinct, bold coloring means the creature has eaten recently.

name: Savage Snapvine
description: The Snapvines have always been dangerous, but we never realized that the deep variants were independent, and could fly. Why would anyone want to find one of those things, much less ride one? But the fruit is good.

name: Hypo-Speed X6000
description: A compilation of nuts, bolts, gears, and treated wood paneling make for an unusually speedy ride.

name: Fluffy Comfy Flying Quilt
description: Woven together by some of the finest Dalaran mages, this flying quilt is known for its comfort and fluffy pillows.

name: Gruffy Comfy Flying Quilt
description: Woven together by some of the grumpiest Dalaran mages, this flying quilt is known for its comfort and fluffy pillows.

name: Comfy Bel'ameth Flying Quilt
description: Ainderu Summerleaf's hand-woven quilts are popular among the children of Bel'ameth.

name: Comfy Silvermoon Flying Quilt
description: Sempstress Ambershine's enchanted quilts became a must-buy trend for the noble-borne children of Silvermoon City.

name: Vivacious Chloroceros
description: Catching a chloroceros mane leaf mid-air is considered a sign of good luck among the Haranir. The more vivacious the leaf, the greater the luck.

name: Vivid Chloroceros
description: The healthier the chloroceros, the more vivid the foliage.

name: Fel Spirehawk
description: Looking into the eyes of this mystical beast is like peering into the heart of a fel corrupted sun. Goggles are recommended when you're riding.

name: Unbound Manawyrm
description: The turbulent void magics that have gripped the Sunwell are attracting the rare great manawyrms, corrupting them as they feed on the unbound magics.

name: Anu'shalla, Shadow's Guidance
description: Her wings cut through the sky like shadows on a moonlit night.

name: Gilnean Iron Charger
description: This noble horse has seen some battles during the curse uprising.

name: Gilnean Copper Charger
description: Carve through the night on this loyal, stalwart steed.

name: Pyrewood Rebel's Rouncey
description: After diligent training from riders in both worgen and human forms, these horses will now bear any rider in Gilnean finery.

name: Gilneas Loyalist's Rouncey
description: Steadfast and proud, this steed carries its rider with quiet dignity and unyielding resolve.

name: Blossomback Arboon
description: Once a common sight in the mountains surrounding the Jade Forest, the arboon's return signals the forest may be healing.

name: Amberback Arboon
description: The golden blossoms of the amberback arboon are a sign of its age and wisdom. A rarity among rarities, even seeing one is considered good luck.

name: Magister's Spell Bee
description: A few Silvermoon Magisters once dedicated their arcane thesis to the study of infusing local flora with arcane-flecked pollen and the effects it had on pollinator species. To the Grand Magister, it was a success. To Silvermoon's Gardeners, it was not.

name: Void-Touched Hawkstrider
description: Almost no beasts are immune to the void's touch. A few of our scouts' hawkstriders have been affected by the void. I have been observing them now for a bit and they are still fit for service. In some ways they are even more fit for the kind of work you are up to. - Sergeant Vornin

name: Zothwing Darkseeker
description: Do not let its cloying looks fool you--zothwing darkseekers are a remnant of an ancient Black Empire species. Pay no attention to whispers mentioning "snackies" for your "trusty mount."

name: Zothwing Deepseeker
description: A gift of N'Zoth, Zothwing Deepseekers are as at home in the crushing depths of Azeroth's oceans as they are in the bitter cold of the void.

name: Dusk-Painted Sun Roc
description: Long ago, the dusk-painted silhouettes of these sun rocs inspired many fireside myths. Their return to Kalimdor has reignited lost stories of these heralds of An'she.

name: Flame-Painted Sun Roc
description: In ages past, the sun rocs of Kalimdor were believed to be the messengers of An'she, carrying with them the first flame before dawn and the final light of evenfall.

name: Golden Ashened Cataclysm
description: In the corners of Azeroth, stories are told of a dreaded dragon who swept a pall of torment over the land. In some versions of this story, his fiery presence brought cataclysmic death and destruction worldwide. In other versions, he is blue. Still in other versions, he is gold.

name: Sha-Warped Riding Wolf
description: Sha has warped this wolf into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

name: Luminous Sporeglider
description: This sporeglider's voracious appetite for luminescent spores has lent it an exquisite glow.

name: Sha-Warped Owl
description: Sha has warped this owl into an even more fearsome creature. The emotions that flow through this creature make it an unmistakable harbinger of doom.

name: Void-Corrupted Hex Eagle
description: A vile ritual can give the ritual master great power. It can also give the target of the ritual great power. This can sometimes go well or poorly for the ritual master.

name: Void-Touched Snapdragon
description: The snapdragon is a resilient creature and loyal by nature. This has made them preferred companions of the naga. However, their latest ritual has made this snapdragon ready for a new home.

name: Spring Panda
description: Equipped with bamboo tools, food and a napping cub, the Spring Panda is ready for an amazing adventure.

name: Blackwater X-TREME Firework Rocket
description: There is no guarantee this rocket will get you where you want to go in one piece. Warning: Rockets explode!

name: Bilgewater X-TREME Firework Rocket
description: The engineers of Undermine were so preoccupied with whether or not they COULD make a faster rocket, they didn't stop to think if they should.

name: Sunflare Driftmoth
description: Although they offer some of the smoothest rides of any mounts in the world, the Sunflare Driftmoth are rare to find in the wild, and rarer still to tame.

name: Spirit of Tok'jara
description: Now freed from the curse, the great eagle Tok'jara continues to serve the Amani even through death.

name: Tuskarr Hermit Crab
description: This crab longs to see the world alongside its Tidesworn Elder. The elder is happy to pay you for your troubles through the granting of Tidesworn Augment Runes.

name: Hearthkeeper's Wandering Caravan
description: Comfortable as your own home and adventurous as a tortollan trader, the Hearthkeeper's Wandering Caravan will carry you in luxurious style anywhere your travels on Azeroth take you.

name: Rabbit'ath
description: The presence of Rabbit'ath brings doom and despair to all who witness. Legend says that in its eyes, you can glimpse the end of all things.

name: Voidmancer's Starcarver
description: This pinnacle of Voidmancer transport technology was once a symbol of status and power among high ranking domanaar. After its creator mysteriously vanished, it was viewed as unseemly when used on core worlds gatherings.

name: Netherforged Nullframe
description: Assembled by the Lightforged, sundered by the Hal'hadar, and restored by a Technomancer. A matrix of light, void, and arcane swirls within this renewed Warframe.

name: Badlands Buzzard
description: The white buzzards are some of the rarest in all the Badlands. Rumor has it that one may even be caught and tamed to fight alongside hunters.

name: Vicious Lightbloom Boar
description: Motes of energy surround this mount, occasionally reflecting a ray of light across your vision.

name: Vicious Lightbloom Boar
description: Motes of energy surround this mount, occasionally reflecting a ray of light across your vision.

name: Autumnal Witchwick's Rider
description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

name: Cerulean Deathwalker
description: A frozen tide of wailing souls, locked in cerulean ice, grinds onward under the weight of eternal suffering.

name: Amethyst Mechsuit
description: Where diamond reflects perfection, amethyst resonates with power.

name: Blue-Chip Shreddertank
description: It may not be exciting, but it makes money every time.

name: Profit-Green Shreddertank
description: If it's leaking, it's working.

name: Speculative Shreddertank
description: The numbers look great if it doesn't explode.

name: High-Yield Shreddertank
description: High return. High risk. Non-refundable.

name: Mossy Witchwick's Rider
description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

name: Moonlit Witchwick's Rider
description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

name: Scarlet Witchwick's Rider
description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

name: Blushing Witchwick's Rider
description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

name: Carmine Witchwick's Rider
description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

name: Sea-Dwelling Isle Serpent
description: This oozing serpent has a taste for fish. As long as you can feed them, they should remain friendly. Should.

name: Caustic Venomfang
description: This venomfang's toxins are potent enough to liquidate its prey in seconds.

name: Crimson Venomfang
description: A venomfang's most deadly weapon is its terrifying tail, which can mortally envenom its prey with a mere scratch.

name: Auriferous Venomfang
description: Its stealth foiled by bright scales, this venomfang lurks among hidden treasure for the next meal.

name: Apophic Soul Crusher
description: Once powered by the arcane, now fueled solely by the tortured spirits of the unfaithful.

name: Primeval Skyfriend
description: The most vicious elder skyfiends lurk within the confines of the Venomous Abyss, surfacing only to stalk prey across the shores of Atal'Utek before returning to their fetid lairs. This one has become your sky-friend.

name: Hexflame Reaver
description: Its glow is a warning: the hunt is already over.

name: Preyhunter's Fury
description: You don't follow tracks; you follow the fading green fire.

name: Tortured Gorger
description: Both domanaar and ethereals have tried to cage this devourer. Each time they have failed. Now, soaked in the energies of the void, this tormented gorger is ready to unleash havoc.

name: Sun Festival's Painted Roc
description: Long ago, this elusive summer roc inspired many legends, many believing them to be descendants of phoenixes. The ancient tauren saw these majestic creatures as living manifestations of An'she's fire.

name: Corroded Soul Crusher
description: Aeons passed without leaving a mark upon its arcane frame. It took the corrosive ichor of Ula'Tek to finally erode what eternity could not.

name: Shadow Spirehawk
description: Looking into the eyes of this mystical beast is like peering into a solar eclipse. Goggles are recommended when you're riding.

name: Topaz Skyfang
description: This elusive wind serpent likes to hide in the forest canopy before stooping down on unsuspecting prey.

name: Emerald Skyfang
description: Found patrolling the skies of Atal'Utek, maintaining the peace and a full stomach.

name: Violet-Backed Skyfang
description: The wind serpents of Atal'Utek have venomous tails. You can thank Ula'tek for that.

name: The Writhing Brood
description: A grotesque conglomerate of serpents, it has yielded to you after witnessing your battle against The Writhing Coil.

name: Indigo Coiled Horror
description: Writhes have three distinct temperaments, making them three times as difficult to tame.

name: Ruby Writhe
description: Riding on a writhe makes it thrice as nice.

name: Venomous Coiler
description: A native of the deadly venom pits within the Vaults of Atal'Utek, this monstrosity poisons the air it slithers past.

name: Breath of Blight
description: A sickly haze trails in its wake, poisoning earth, air, and anything foolish enough to pursue it.

name: Breath of Ruin
description: Where its shadow falls, even the bravest hear the echo of forgotten wars.

name: Crested Ember Leafmimic
description: This sturdy leafmimic can be found only in the warmest of areas. Its red scales allow it to hide undiscovered in the heated alcoves it prefers.

name: Crested Aqua Leafmimic
description: The aqua leafmimic is a rare sight indeed. Found only in the forests of Ashenvale, its darkened scales allow it to hide among the trees and groves undetected.

name: Crested Verdant Leafmimic
description: Found primarily in areas with dense vegetation, this leafmimic is rarely spotted due to the natural hues of its scales, allowing it to blend in with its surroundings.

name: Crested Violet Leafmimic
description: The violet leafmimic can be found in most dense jungles -- but only if your eyesight is keen. The patterns on their scales allow them to blend in with the vibrant foliage and shadows.

name: Cerulean Prideclaw
description: A fierce and loyal mount that will accompany you on all your journeys.

name: Wintry Witchwick's Rider
description: Sleek, stylish, and spooky, the Witchwick Rider offers a smooth and surprisingly comfortable ride, thanks to the ergonomic saddle requested by many a spellcaster seeking cushioned support.

name: Veteran Adventurer's Loyal Companion
description: When it is time to answer the call to adventure, this bear will be ready to take you there.

name: Land Shark
description: After birth, newborn sharks quickly flee their hungry mothers. Their early independence makes them dangerous, even while young.

name: Personal World Destroyer
description: Goblin engineering at its finest. Blueprints based on the massive fel reaver in Hellfire Peninsula.

name: De-Weaponized Mechanical Companion
description: The gold standard for sturdy gnomish design, this mechanical critter is the perfect companion for the lonely engineer on the go.

name: Crawling Claw
description: This appears to be nothing more than the paw of a small primate. A closer inspection shows that the hand has been dried by centuries of exposure to the sands of Uldum.

name: Fossilized Hatchling
description: You stare at her, and she just stares right back. So clever; sometimes it seems as if she's figuring out how to open doors.

name: Enchanted Lantern
description: Reduces the likelihood of being eaten by monsters when you enter pitch-black places.

name: Lil' Deathwing
description: Nations tremble under his shadow - the Destroyer, the one-time Aspect of Earth, and the monster responsible for breaking Azeroth asunder. Now in a convenient travel-size!

name: Rustberg Gull
description: This bird is a salty veteran of the endless naval battles surrounding Tol Barad--a veteran whose grown plump from picking through the leftovers, that is.

name: Fox Kit
description: The fighting in Tol Barad has made it difficult to find these kits, and numerous would-be owners have decimated the fox population there as a result.

name: Tiny Shale Spider
description: The elemental shale spider is no true arachnid, but it has durability and ferocity that make it feared even in Deepholm.

name: Mr. Grubbs
description: The grubs of the Plaguelands are a side effect of necromantic corruption and the massive number of corpses there. Mr. Grubbs is from a particularly acrobatic breed.

name: Scooter the Snail
description: You'll find him in his shell, exactly where a snail has to be!

name: Singing Sunflower
description: This sweet flower will brighten your day with its warm smile and cheerful song! Also strong against undead.

name: Magic Lamp
description: Higitus figi- hockity pocki- abracadab- prestidig--oh, pinfeathers!

name: Elementium Geode
description: Often confused by miners as a rare gem, the geode initially makes its presence known by emitting melodic reverberations.

name: Deathy
description: Deathwing's emergence transformed the whole of Azeroth; not even the ocean-dwelling murlocs were immune to his corrupt influence.

name: Moonkin Hatchling
description: Moonkin are blessed by Elune and spread nature's grace wherever they travel. The festive fowls are always in the mood for a dance.

name: Lil' Ragnaros
description: It's never too soon to summon this tiny aspect of the dread Firelord.

name: Panther Cub
description: It looked up at you with those huge black eyes and seemed to ask, 'Are you my mommy?'

name: Nightsaber Cub
description: Elune made nightsabers silver and black so they could meld into the shadows on a moonlit night.

name: Winterspring Cub
description: Winterspring cubs are happiest when frolicking in freshly fallen snow.

name: Guardian Cub
description: Still a little clumsy, this tiny winged lion is learning how to be the best mount it can be!

name: Feline Familiar
description: Ride with the moon (and this furry, whiskered witch) in the dead of night!

name: Nuts
description: Most squirrels hoard acorns for sustenance. Nuts, on the other hand, hoards acorns to stock its supply of ammunition.

name: Purple Puffer
description: You might think this fish out of water would be a weak opponent... until you see the intensity that lies within its protective bubble.

name: Murkablo
description: When you're confronting Murkablo or any of the Prime Murlocs, possession of a soulstone is strongly advised.

name: Darkmoon Monkey
description: The monkeys of Azeroth are infamous tricksters, and these beloved companions of the Darkmoon Faire have taken that innate cunning to a whole new level.

name: Alliance Balloon
description: Created to entertain children at the Darkmoon Faire, these magical balloons never lose their floatiness.

name: Horde Balloon
description: A magical wonder, these balloons will never deflate and are traditionally created in batches of ninety-nine.

name: Gregarious Grell
description: The grell are embodiments of the wild side of nature. Tame ones are very rare.

name: Darkmoon Turtle
description: This shelled reptile bravely protects the home on its back with an unwaveringly happy disposition.

name: Darkmoon Balloon
description: It just floats along...

name: Sea Pony
description: Despite its diminutive size, it is impossible to miss a sea pony cutting through the water.

name: Lunar Lantern
description: These magical lanterns are acquired at the Lunar Festival, which celebrates the defeat of the Burning Legion by the free races of Azeroth.

name: Festival Lantern
description: The light from each lantern honors the soul of an ancestor spirit. During the Lunar Festival, these ghostly elders pass along their wisdom to the current generation.

name: Darkmoon Cub
description: This snuggly kitten loves to frolic, but sometimes it seems to be chasing things that aren't really there.

name: Fetish Shaman
description: Fetish shaman are empowered by the spirits of their fallen ancestors. These malevolent spirits are bound to the shaman's tribal spear. Control this spear, and you control the shaman.

name: Soul of the Aspects
description: The Soul of the Aspects is said to be possessed of mercurial moods ranging from stoic and deliberate to unpredictable and erratic, to loving and deeply pensive.

name: Black Lamb
description: Offspring of the black sheep, the black lamb is only found in the forests of Elwynn.

name: Rabbit
description: When you have two rabbits, you'll often soon have three.

name: Squirrel
description: Most people do not know the difference between a squirrel and a chipmunk. Most don't care.

name: Bucktooth Flapper
description: It's hard to know what's more dangerous: the teeth or the tail.

name: Porcupette
description: Despite the name you should absolutely never, ever pet it.

name: Sun Darter Hatchling
description: This unique species of faerie dragon is not usually found on Azeroth.

name: Eternal Strider
description: It seems like a trick to the eyes, but the eternal strider can walk across water, its small feet never breaking the surface.

name: Mouse
description: It seems that mice are completely incapable of resisting cheese even in the face of imprisonment, injury, or death.

name: Prairie Dog
description: Distinct from their tree dwelling cousins, these ground squirrels make their homes on the plains of Azeroth and beyond.

name: Shore Crab
description: These arthropods line many Azerothian shores and seek to fulfill their one true desire: to pinch.

name: Mountain Cottontail
description: Mountain cottontails can leap up a steep incline with speed you would not believe.

name: Redridge Rat
description: The rats in Redridge grow fat from feasting on the bounty of the village larders.

name: Dusk Spiderling
description: Native to Duskwood, these eight-legged critters are often used as ingredients in alchemy potions.

name: Black Rat
description: While many people believe black cats to be bad luck, black rats are held in higher esteem.

name: Widow Spiderling
description: Widow spiderlings have plenty of time to explore Duskwood once they take care of their pesky family commitments.

name: Strand Crab
description: The low tide reveals the colonies of strand crabs and the sound of their clicking dance as they feed upon small creatures hidden in the sand.

name: Swamp Moth
description: Prefers to dwell in wet, muddy areas and feed on Sorrowmoss nectar.

name: Long-Tailed Mole
description: Thought by many to be nothing more than the subject of children's nursery rhymes, the long-tailed mole is very much real.

name: Beetle
description: A hardy insect that can dwell in just about any climate, the beetle is known to thrive on battlefields after the fighting has ended.

name: Forest Spiderling
description: This vicious species weaves elaborate webs throughout the dense jungles of Stranglethorn Vale.

name: Lizard Hatchling
description: If a female lizard does not lay her clutch in a well camouflaged area, her eggs will likely be devoured by Lashtail Raptors.

name: Wharf Rat
description: Just like the rough and tumble sailors who live dockside, the wharf rats are feral, violent creatures.

name: Spider
description: The most common of the arachnid family, these critters spin their webs in nearly every corner of Azeroth.

name: Fire Beetle
description: Drawn to heat and the smell of smoke, the fire beetle's diet consists of ash.

name: Rat
description: The intrepid archaeologist Harrison Jones has a well documented fear of rats.

name: Small Frog
description: This is a small frog.

name: Toad
description: The song of late summer nights is the song of toads.

name: Crimson Moth
description: Prefers to dwell in humid, tropical areas and feed on Kingsblood nectar.

name: Lava Crab
description: The thick exoskeleton of this adaptable arthropod allows it to thrive in harsh environments.

name: Ash Spiderling
description: The rock-hard carapaces of these spiders allow them to survive in the Searing Gorge's blistering heat.

name: Molten Hatchling
description: These blisteringly hot spiders camouflage themselves by blending in with oozing magma.

name: Lava Beetle
description: Beetles in the Burning Steppes roll magma into tiny balls and eat them once they cool off.

name: Gold Beetle
description: Tiny, autonomous machines created by the Titans to clean and maintain their mighty edifices.

name: Spiky Lizard
description: The coloration of the spiky lizard allows it to blend in seamlessly with the desert sands of Silithus.

name: Snow Cub
description: The thick snow near Dun Morogh acts as camouflage for snow cubs learning to hunt.

name: Alpine Hare
description: The alpine hare can burrow into the permafrost and hibernate for weeks or even months.

name: Grasslands Cottontail
description: Despite their idyllic surroundings, grasslands cottontails hop at surprising speed when evading their pursuers.

name: Jade Oozeling
description: Jade Oozelings glow in the dark, making them a welcome sight to workers in pitch-black mineshafts.

name: Hare
description: A carrot, a box, a stick, and some string. Wait a few hours and you'll have a hare.

name: Brown Marmot
description: Distinct from their Azerothian relatives, these critters of Outland make their home in Blade's Edge Mountains.

name: Maggot
description: The preferred habitat of this creature is woodland areas where it can safely complete its metamorphosis.

name: Red-Tailed Chipmunk
description: According to the tales of the night elves, the first red-tailed chipmunk was colored so after the theft and consumption of a sacred apple.

name: Undercity Rat
description: Even the rats of Lordaeron fell to the apothecaries' plague, chewing upon the tainted flesh of the dead.

name: Blighted Squirrel
description: Undead squirrels have acquired a taste for the strange berries and mushrooms that now grow in Silverpine Forest.

name: Festering Maggot
description: It can swallow three times its own body weight in blood.

name: Cat
description: After centuries of domestication, these furry critters inhabit nearly every human nation in the Eastern Kingdoms.

name: Larva
description: This new arrival to Azeroth was spawned a short time ago. It seeks to thrive while awaiting its next phase of evolution.

name: Spirit Crab
description: The souls of slain crabs seek vengeance against the murlocs who ate them.

name: Spiny Lizard
description: The children of Orgrimmar frequently capture these lizards as pets. The adults of Orgrimmar frequently step on them.

name: Dung Beetle
description: A desert dwelling forager attracted to areas rich with dung.

name: Creepy Crawly
description: These beetles often make their homes in quarries abandoned by the Horde war machine in Durotar.

name: Twilight Beetle
description: An enigmatic species, said to feed off the chaotic energies of the Old Gods.

name: Twilight Spider
description: Twisted by the Twilight Hammer's dark magic, these sinister critters are known to feed on their own young.

name: Rabid Nut Varmint 5000
description: Considered by most to be a significant improvement to the 4000 series, there were nonetheless serious concerns about the amount of heat they produced.

name: Turquoise Turtle
description: Turtles are feared by the naga, who consider them bad luck and give them a wide berth on the shores of Azshara.

name: Cheetah Cub
description: These playful feline cubs practice their hunting skills by stalking each other through the Barrens.

name: Forest Moth
description: Prefers to dwell in cool, forested areas and feed on Mageroyal nectar.

name: Elfin Rabbit
description: Their proximity to the magic of the elves has caused some of them unnatural long life. And in some elfin rabbits...stranger things.

name: Topaz Shale Hatchling
description: Prized by gem crafters, the undamaged carapace of a topaz hatchling can be used to create stunning inlays for rings and bracelets.

name: Horny Toad
description: There are many scholars who question whether it is a toad or not.

name: Desert Spider
description: This cunning species tunnels beneath Uldum and erupts from the ground to ensnare its prey.

name: Stone Armadillo
description: When these sleepy critters aren't snoozing, they use their massive claws to dig for tasty insect snacks.

name: Alpine Chipmunk
description: Many an explorer has been entranced by the adorable nature of the alpine chipmunk, failing to notice its small teeth on frostbitten digits.

name: Sand Kitten
description: Originally bred by the Sandfury trolls as pets, these feral and savage felines prowl the deserts of Tanaris.

name: Stinkbug
description: A desert-dwelling insect which defends its eggs by spraying a foul, ogrelike scent.

name: Shimmershell Snail
description: Hunts for food just below the water's surface on the coast of Darkshore.

name: Frog
description: For every frog, a prince and princess in waiting.

name: Rusty Snail
description: Don't let their lack of a face fool you--these slimy critters are angry and just itching for a fight.

name: Tainted Moth
description: Prefers to dwell in corrupted woodlands and feed on Purple Lotus nectar.

name: Tainted Rat
description: There are some things too dirty even for rats.

name: Spotted Bell Frog
description: The dwarven explorer who first discovered the spotted bell frog could not decide between naming it after the unique spot pattern or the sound of the frog's mating ritual. She chose both.

name: Silky Moth
description: Prefers to dwell in the shadow of Nordrassil and feed on Stormvine nectar.

name: Diemetradon Hatchling
description: Diemetradons abandon their hatchlings in Un'Goro Crater to fend for themselves. Only the strongest survive.

name: Twilight Iguana
description: Although most reptiles enjoy basking in sunlight, these scaly beasts love bathing in the glow of Azeroth's twin moons.

name: Venomspitter Hatchling
description: These eight-legged critters have lurked in the shadowy cliffs of the Stonetalon Mountains for millennia.

name: Scarab Hatchling
description: Spawn of the nefarious Shrieker Scarabs of Ahn'Qiraj, the hatchlings are much more docile (and quiet) than their parents.

name: Fel Flame
description: Born from demonic magic, these petulant little entities corrupt everything they touch with foul energies.

name: Devouring Maggot
description: Howling Fjord teems with the ever shifting cycle of life. When a creature dies, its body is quickly consumed by maggots, which in turn pass those nutrients on to a number of other creatures.

name: Oily Slimeling
description: These living blobs of ooze lack even the most rudimentary form of intelligence, but that doesn't mean they can't be your friend.

name: Imperial Eagle Chick
description: The taunka collect the feathers of these noble birds of prey to use in crude fortunetelling ceremonies.

name: Grotto Vole
description: Grotto voles are often confused with mice. Never twice.

name: Carrion Rat
description: Where there is carrion, there will always be rats.

name: Mac Frog
description: Flamboyantly colored and more exuberant than most frogs.

name: Oasis Moth
description: Prefers to dwell along desert streams, wells or watering holes and feed on Whiptail nectar.

name: Tol'vir Scarab
description: Carrion feeders often found in large numbers within ancient unearthed tombs; they can survive long periods of time without feeding.

name: Yellow-Bellied Marmot
description: Distinct from their plain dwelling relatives, these critters make their homes amidst the war-torn Twilight Highlands.

name: Highlands Mouse
description: The mice of the highlands, perhaps twisted by the Twilight's Hammer, are aggressive and fight for dominance between each other.

name: Stowaway Rat
description: In the lean times when adrift at sea, the sight of a rat was a welcome one.

name: Crimson Shale Hatchling
description: Through experimentation, the mages of Dalaran have discovered that the powered remains of a crimson shale spider will greatly increase the conflagration of their fire spells.

name: Crystal Beetle
description: A cousin to the Twilight Beetle, this insect has learned to feed on crystals which resonate with ancient energies.

name: Arctic Fox Kit
description: During frigid nights in the Storm Peaks, these critters use their fluffy tails as a blanket to stay warm.

name: Crimson Geode
description: Therazane wore these spunky crimson elementals as jewelry before the azure craze swept through Deepholm.

name: Sea Gull
description: The seagull is a coastal scavenger often found near the docks.

name: Emerald Turtle
description: It is difficult to believe that Shen-zin Su, on whose shell rests all of the Wandering Isle, began life as a tiny emerald turtle.

name: Jungle Darter
description: In the jungle, every leaf could conceal a frog. Stop to check and it could be long gone.

name: Mirror Strider
description: When preparing to travel to distant locations, Pandaren will traditionally capture a mirror strider and safely relocate it to another body of water.

name: Silkbead Snail
description: Hides in shell to escape claws of nearby crabs.

name: Garden Frog
description: One of the stranger nuisances to horticulturalists, garden frogs can cause untold damage to gardens.

name: Masked Tanuki
description: There's a raging debate over whether tanukis are raccoons or dogs, but the distinction seems trivial when they're gnawing on your femur.

name: Spirebound Crab
description: These tiny arthropods are Pandaria natives that call the area of the Windless Isle their home.

name: Sandy Petrel
description: The sandy petrel flies high above the Windless Isle, safe from landbound predators.

name: Infected Squirrel
description: More horrifying than its appearance is that the infected squirrels of the Plaguelands no longer hoard nuts, instead collecting rotten, decaying flesh.

name: Shore Crawler
description: Only found on the shores of Kezan, this lovely sea creature can be a bit snarky.

name: Gilnean Raven
description: Quoth the raven: the last word you said. It gets old.

name: Ash Lizard
description: The ash lizard gets its name from the way its shed skin looks, with an appearance like burnt cinders.

name: Crystal Spider
description: These strange critters glimmer like ice, allowing them to hide among Winterspring's snowy expanses.

name: Skittering Cavern Crawler
description: These arachnids use their razor-sharp legs to carve tunnels in the solid rock of the Blade's Edge Mountains.

name: Borean Marmot
description: Distinct from their cousins found in warmer climes, these hardy critters make their homes in the icy wastes of Northrend.

name: Snowshoe Hare
description: With the extra large surface area of their legs, snowshoe hares are able to effortlessly hop along the snow while their pursuers get bogged down in the drifts.

name: Arctic Hare
description: The heart of an arctic hare beats twice as fast as a common hare.

name: Fjord Rat
description: If not for being extremely accident prone, the fjord rat might take over the world.

name: Chicken
description: Tends to avoid crossing roads, regardless of motivations.

name: Grizzly Squirrel
description: In the deep forest, even the small creatures must have the ferocity to fend for themselves.

name: Huge Toad
description: This is a huge toad.

name: Biletoad
description: The rumors of the medicinal uses of the biletoad were believed to have been started by a particularly mischievous apothecary.

name: Terrible Turnip
description: And you thought turnips at the dinner table were bad.

name: Tiny Goldfish
description: This bubble is way worse than a tank.

name: Sand Scarab
description: Easily mistaken for a common beetle, the sting of a sand scarab will quickly clear up the misconception should you be unlucky enough to be stung by one.

name: Micronax
description: Whenever his forces would experience setbacks in Azeroth, Kil'jaeden would pull out Micronax and terrorize the local cat-like creatures of Argus to vent his frustrations.

name: Lucky Quilen Cub
description: Offspring of the Imperial Quilen.

name: Stormwind Rat
description: Unnoticed but to cats and ratcatchers, when Deathwing descended upon Stormwind all the rats beat a hasty retreat from the city. Only of late have they returned.

name: Shy Bandicoon
description: A goblin alchemist once claimed that the bite of this raccoon gave him the gift of prophecy. Turns out, it was just rabies.

name: Jungle Grub
description: These little green grubs are native to wilds of Pandaria. Its verdant coloration camouflages it from would-be predators.

name: Summit Kid
description: You'll often find them perched high atop impossibly high and remote stone outcroppings. There are few creatures as sure of foot.

name: Kuitan Mongoose
description: The mongoose is prized for its ability to drive off poisonous snakes. Rikk-tikk-tikki-tikki-tchk!

name: Jumping Spider
description: This terrifying and highly venomous species leaps onto its prey from the Jade Forest's dense canopy.

name: Leopard Tree Frog
description: The leopard tree frog was named for the way it pounces from branch to branch.

name: Masked Tanuki Pup
description: Many young raccoons rail against their strict curfews, complaining that dawn is way too early to go to bed.

name: Bandicoon
description: The taciturn bandicoon's diet consists mostly of apples.

name: Bandicoon Kit
description: Some druids say pandaren and raccoons are distant cousins, but never when a pandaren can hear them.

name: Malayan Quillrat
description: Many believe that the quillrat is able to shoot its spines at aggressors.

name: Malayan Quillrat Pup
description: Although the wounds caused by the young quillrat are seldom fatal, most predators seek easier prey.

name: Marsh Fiddler
description: Known to feast on the tasty plants in Valley of the Four Winds.

name: Sifang Otter
description: The sifang otter lives near rivers and is normally friendly and playful.

name: Sifang Otter Pup
description: Otters swim by propelling themselves with their powerful tails and flexing their long bodies. Very fast in the water.

name: Softshell Snapling
description: Softshell turtle meat is considered a delicacy and is the key ingredient in soothing turtle bisque.

name: Feverbite Hatchling
description: The common folk remedy to a feverbite hatchling's bite is to dance wildly and try to sweat out the toxins before they can take hold.

name: Amethyst Spiderling
description: A rarity among arachnids, these non-venomous critters feed solely on plants and fruit.

name: Savory Beetle
description: The most delicious of the beetle family.

name: Luyu Moth
description: A daring, narcissist insect willing to brave any threat in its pursuit of the spotlight.

name: Spiny Terrapin
description: Angering a spiny terrapin will cause it to withdraw into its shell and begin to spin wildly towards an attacker.

name: Alpine Foxling
description: Burrows deep into snowbanks to hide from predators.

name: Alpine Foxling Kit
description: Occasionally sneaks bites of food from kills made by much larger animals.

name: Plains Monitor
description: While stationary, the plains monitor will continuously flick its tail back and forth. From a distance this mimics the appearance of swaying tallgrass, camouflaging the lizard from aerial predators.

name: Prairie Mouse
description: On the prairie there are numerous rodents and other small creatures, but none more common than the mouse.

name: Szechuan Chicken
description: Will only lay eggs in bright light.

name: Tolai Hare
description: In the ancient fables, the first Tolai hare strode across the gulf between the stars before it upset them and they tumbled from the heavens to the world below.

name: Tolai Hare Pup
description: Tolai hare pups are sent from their dens at a young age to find their own way.

name: Amber Moth
description: Known to flourish in the rainy season, this insect is drawn to lightning storms.

name: Grassland Hopper
description: At night, the grassland hoppers fill the night with their maddening song. Those unaccustomed to it have spent many a sleepless night serenaded by their mating calls.

name: Mongoose
description: Contrary to its benign appearance, mongoose are dangerous carnivores, well known for their ability to hunt venomous snakes that could kill much larger creatures.

name: Mongoose Pup
description: Mongoose pups prefer long grass where only their mothers can find them.

name: Yakrat
description: The bond between yak and rat is a strange one, and what the rat gains out of the symbiotic relationship is a mystery.

name: Silent Hedgehog
description: These hedgehogs may be silent, but often are heard the cries of those that foolishly step upon their quills.

name: Clouded Hedgehog
description: Hedgehogs are not at all fond of croquet nor flamingos.

name: Rapana Whelk
description: Has been spotted fighting other whelks for prime food sources.

name: Emperor Crab
description: The emperor crab was named for its regal appearance: the ridges of its shell and its raised claws eerily resembling a crown. One that would pinch your eyes out if you tried to wear it.

name: Gilded Moth
description: This delicate insect's wings are often sewn into clothing and armor.

name: Golden Civet
description: Civets are landbound cousins of the otter and are prized for their heady musks.

name: Golden Civet Kitten
description: The civets are known to guard their young ferociously.

name: Dancing Water Skimmer
description: Named for their apparent dancelike behavior when skimming aquatic surfaces, the species uses erratic movements to avoid being devoured by fish and other underwater predators.

name: Yellow-Bellied Bullfrog
description: Despite its menacing appearance, the yellow-bellied bullfrog was aptly named.

name: Garden Moth
description: Known to flourish in the rainy season, this insect is drawn to lightning storms.

name: Fungal Moth
description: Prefers to dwell in dark caves and feed on Heartblossom nectar.

name: Jade Crane Chick
description: A graceful creature from the isle of Pandaria.

name: Thundering Serpent Hatchling
description: A baby version of the mighty Thundering Cloud Serpent that hails from the far lands of Pandaria.

name: Wild Jade Hatchling
description: So cute, yet so epic.

name: Wild Golden Hatchling
description: The offspring of Tsulong, hidden away before the corruption of the Sha had fully taken hold of the Terrace of Endless Spring.

name: Wild Crimson Hatchling
description: It's red, so it must fly faster.

name: Singing Cricket
description: Known to feast on the tasty plants in Krasarang Wilds.

name: Feral Vermling
description: It keeps looking at me. I think it wants to bite me.

name: Hopling
description: The great big world can be a dangerous place for such a tiny, adorable creature.

name: Aqua Strider
description: Water striders serve an important role in Jinyu culture, acting as a mount, means of sending communications, and even a family pet.

name: Emerald Shale Hatchling
description: Adventurers have reported rare sightings of a monstrous sized emerald shale spider, which the denizens of Deepholm have come to call the Jadefang.

name: Amethyst Shale Hatchling
description: Adult amethyst shale spiders prefer to create their nests against the outer walls of Deepholm.

name: Mechanical Pandaren Dragonling
description: Constructed from a seemingly impossible mass of gears, springs, wires, and a little something special, this dragonling embodies the spirit of Pandaria as seen through an engineer's goggles.

name: Fishy
description: Many believe (incorrectly) that goldfish have no memories. Trainers who have worked with them know this is clearly not the case and have the bruises to prove it.

name: Darkmoon Rabbit
description: This rabbit is much stronger than it looks.

name: Chi-Ji Kite
description: A beautiful kite brought to life by the scribes of Pandaria.

name: Yu'lon Kite
description: Who knew scribes could make kites?

name: Horned Lizard
description: Not only is it quick, it's loud too!

name: Venus
description: Seems odd that he doesn't like flies... right?

name: Pandaren Water Spirit
description: Water spirits are especially mischievous, and are known to frequent the canals of the Stormstout Brewery.

name: Baneling
description: A rolling, explosive member of the Zerg swarm, the baneling deals terrible, terrible damage. Very dangerous in close quarters.

name: Wanderer's Festival Hatchling
description: Legend has it that a seadragon turtle just like this one grew up to become Shen-zin Su, the Wandering Isle. Perhaps your little turtle will grow into something amazing?

name: Imperial Silkworm
description: This plump red caterpillar is world-renowned for creating the finest silk in Azeroth.

name: Red Cricket
description: Be careful, he might eat all your crops!

name: Darkmoon Hatchling
description: Most of Violet's numerous forest strider hatchlings are turned into Faire fare by Stamp Thunderhorn, though a few are raised as mounts or purchased by adventurers looking for a petite purple pet.

name: Darkmoon Eye
description: Don't even think about cheating now.

name: Crow
description: While smaller than the infamous ravens of Gilneas, crows are no less clever or cunning.

name: Cinder Kitten
description: A playful, purring pyromaniac. Don't pet these kittens without fireproof mittens!

name: Pandaren Fire Spirit
description: Though it appears to be a vaguely-related cousin to the Cinder Kitten, the two creatures actually share no ancestry.

name: Pandaren Air Spirit
description: These spirits represent the heart of Pandaria's elemental powers.

name: Pandaren Earth Spirit
description: The elements of Pandaria can be cute and playful, until their homeland is threatened.

name: Sumprush Rodent
description: A rodent of usual size.

name: Giant Bone Spider
description: Found in a dusty egg clutch at the back of Maexxna's lair, these creatures are already undead when they hatch.

name: Mr. Bigglesworth
description: Upon exiting the freezing necropolis of Naxxramas, Mr. Bigglesworth promptly found a warm spot in the sun to take a long nap in.

name: Corefire Imp
description: These tiny flame imps roam the Molten Core in large swarms and can replenish their numbers rapidly.

name: Ashstone Core
description: The cooled core of Golemagg, it appears to retain some semi-sentient properties.

name: Lofty Libram
description: Most people have never read this book.

name: Arcane Eye
description: Never take your eye off of it.

name: Fluxfire Feline
description: Originally created by the engineers in the bowels of Gnomeregan, the Fluxfire Feline is a marvel of modern engineering.

name: Anodized Robo Cub
description: The engineering wizards in Everlook created this unique cub as a test model. Unfortunately a few went rogue and were never recovered.

name: Cogblade Raptor
description: This model of raptors is produced in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Their robotic roars are a common sound near Toshley Station.

name: Kun-Lai Runt
description: Indigenous to the peaks of Kun-Lai Summit, this rare yeti is much more dangerous than it looks.

name: Gusting Grimoire
description: A fel-tainted tome whose secrets are so terrible and bizarre that its pages have taken on an eerie semblance of life. Found on many a warlock's nightstand.

name: Thundertail Flapper
description: Touched by lightning, these dangerous rodents should be kept at a safe distance.

name: Living Sandling
description: Born of sand, these dangerous creatures can form and disperse in the blink of an eye.

name: Electrified Razortooth
description: Lightning can be seen flowing across its body, teeth to tail.

name: Zandalari Kneebiter
description: This unique raptor was born on the island of Zandalar and transported here along with the rest of the Zandalari army.

name: Elder Python
description: These snakes have been known to swallow gnomes in one gulp.

name: Swamp Croaker
description: Probably best not to touch it.

name: Son of Animus
description: Forged in the Throne of Thunder, these tiny creations are servants of the great Dark Animus.

name: Stunted Direhorn
description: Even at this tiny size, Direhorns are known to wreak havoc on unsuspecting victims.

name: Spectral Porcupette
description: Something about this creature looks familiar...

name: Pygmy Direhorn
description: Don't pet the pointy end. Note: all of the ends are pointy.

name: Spawn of G'nathus
description: Some Pandaren believe G'nathus to be an ancient Zandalari Loa left behind to guard the waters south of Lei Shen's island citadel.

name: Ji-Kun Hatchling
description: Deadly offspring of the Ancient Mother, Ji-Kun Hatchlings are considered sacred treasures in many cultures.

name: Pierre
description: Every cook's dream wrapped up in a perfect bundle of metal and bolts. Too bad what he cooks up isn't suitable for humanoid consumption. According to Jard's notes, he intends to make this little guy for his friend, Emily Cole.

name: Direhorn Runt
description: The Zandalari breed specific Direhorn species for their small size for use as mounts.

name: Tiny Red Carp
description: The red scales on these fish are believed to be a warning to predators of the Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes that their flesh is toxic. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

name: Tiny Blue Carp
description: These little guys can be found in the waters of the Timeless Isle, or swimming alongside Jewel Danio or Redbelly Mandarin. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

name: Tiny Green Carp
description: It is believed that the green coloration and stripes on the tiny green carp serve as camouflage in the waters of the Jade Forest, Valley of the Four Winds and the Krasarang Wilds. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

name: Tiny White Carp
description: These hardy fish can survive in a wide range of climates, from the snow capped mountains of Kun-Lai Summit to the temperate, salty waters of the oceans around Pandaria. Dedicated fishermen can sometimes befriend one.

name: Zandalari Anklerender
description: These tiny minions of Zandalar are adept at stowing away within the cargo holds of the enormous Zandalari warships.

name: Zandalari Footslasher
description: Even at this size, these raptors can eviscerate an entire cow in less than 10 seconds.

name: Zandalari Toenibbler
description: These adorable beasts are both cuddly and huggable, provided you do not enjoy having a face.

name: Fiendish Imp
description: A minion of Terestian Illhoof, this tricky imp was left in Karazhan when the portal to the Twisting Nether closed behind it.

name: Pocket Reaver
description: Sent through the Twisting Nether by the great Archimonde the Defiler to terrorize tiny civilizations with their medium-sized stomping noises.

name: Unborn Val'kyr
description: Val'kyr are considered "unborn" until they vanquish a creature of high nobility.

name: Living Fluid
description: The dark pools in Primordius' chamber laid stagnant after the fall of the mogu, and murky thoughts began to coalesce.

name: Viscous Horror
description: These malicious oozes are highly sensitive to Primordius' pheromone signature.

name: Filthling
description: Battle pet trainers are strongly encouraged to wash their hands for at least 30 minutes after playing with the filthling.

name: Blossoming Ancient
description: This budding ancient is a unique variety in Azeroth, created from the ever-living branches of the Great Tree, and can bloom in any season.

name: Zeradar
description: Infamous psionic battering ram of the Protoss, Zeradar is also the only archon that can utilize psionic storm. Power overwhelming!

name: Rascal-Bot
description: This little guy seems to like to hang out at the fringes of cataclysmic events. There is no evidence to suggest he has anything to do with the cause of these events, though - he's probably just an observer. Or maybe he just gets lost on his trek to other places.

name: Xu-Fu, Cub of Xuen
description: Fierce and loyal, Xu-Fu loves to hunt by moonlight. Once during a full moon, he killed and ate an entire Ironfur Great Bull, prompting a two day nap.

name: Chi-Chi, Hatchling of Chi-Ji
description: Chi-Chi tries to inspire hope with her loud squawk and by chasing, and eventually eating, butterflies.

name: Yu'la, Broodling of Yu'lon
description: A master sculptor devoted her life to creating an incomparably beautiful statue, inspired by her love and reverence for Yu'lon. When the sculptor passed away, Yu'lon breathed a fraction of her essence into the statue, bringing Yu'la into the world.

name: Zao, Calfling of Niuzao
description: Always on the lookout for a fight or some tasty grass, Zao keeps his head down and eyes forward.

name: Lil' Bling
description: This handsome little robot is the spitting image of his "Dad", Blingtron 4000. As a Blingtron's generosity circuits don't mature until they have been built to maximum specification, you shouldn't expect any free handouts from him.

name: Azure Crane Chick
description: Crane chicks of the Timeless Isle sometimes sing a curious song that calms the nerves and soothes the soul.

name: Ashleaf Spriteling
description: The Ashleaf Sprites of the Timeless Isle tirelessly protect the vegetation of the island from the burning fury of Ordos and his minions.

name: Ruby Droplet
description: The waters of Ruby Lake are colored a strange reddish hue, possibly due to the ruby crystals found deep within the mountains of the Timeless Isle.

name: Dandelion Frolicker
description: While fascinated by flowers, the frolicker has also been known to dance with blades of grass and the occasional weed.

name: Death Adder Hatchling
description: Late in life, if the environmental conditions are correct, a Death Adder may shed its skin and undergo a transformation into an Imperial Python.

name: Droplet of Y'Shaarj
description: A small remnant of the power of Y'shaarj that spawned the Sha, a single Drop of Y'shaarj can magnify emotional states for thousands of yards, causing entire towns to shut down in fear or doubt.

name: Gooey Sha-ling
description: Sha-lings reflect the emotional state of their handler, becoming agitated, depressed, fearful, or doubtful depending on the magnitude of negative thoughts around them.

name: Jademist Dancer
description: The Jademist Dancers of the Timeless Isle have a curious attraction to the steam vents of the northwestern shore.

name: Kovok
description: The tiny terror of the Dread Wastes, Kovok prefers a steady diet of "brain food:" mushan brains, human brains, any brains really. This strange nutritional requirement may be tangentally related to his enormous head.

name: Ominous Flame
description: The odd blue flames found within the Cavern of Lost Spirits have led many unwary adventurers to their doom.

name: Skunky Alemental
description: When the village of Pi'jiu was attacked by the Ordon Yaungol generations ago, the villagers bravely erected a keg in the center of the village. The following morning, after the celebration had died down, the still-drunken Yaungol blearily agreed to a peace treaty.

name: Spineclaw Crab
description: Spineclaw crabs of Pandaria have existed for thousands of years and remain one of the continent's oldest creatures.

name: Gulp Froglet
description: Gulp frogs of the Timeless Isle can feast upon prey several times larger than themselves by slowly digesting the victim externally with a toxic slime.

name: Bonkers
description: Some young and rambunctious hozen are trained from an early age to use boxing gloves so they don't accidentally kill their tribe members, and more importantly, to keep them from picking their noses.

name: Vengeful Porcupette
description: One of the beasts left on the Timeless Isle when it shifted through time, most likely sacrificed by the Ordon to their demigod, Ordos.

name: Gu'chi Swarmling
description: Swarmlings of Gu'chi spin an ancient, and very powerful, form of silk that has not been seen in Pandaria in ages.

name: Harmonious Porcupette
description: Prolonged exposure to Shaohao's tranquil mists has calmed these spirits, which act as peaceful companions to the Mistweavers.

name: Jadefire Spirit
description: The Jadefire Spirit is thought to be a living embodiment of Yu'lon's own jade breath.

name: Sky Lantern
description: A candle inside of the kite heats the air, causing it to rise into the air without the need for wind.

name: Alterac Brew-Pup
description: A mastiff bred for rescue, the Alterac brewhound's bloodline is famous for having found and resuscitated many mountain travelers trapped beneath the snow... and then slobbering all over them.

name: Murkalot
description: We're Crusaders from a fable. We dance whene'er we're able. We do routines and chorus scenes, with footwork impeccable!

name: Treasure Goblin
description: Watch your coin purse.

name: Dread Hatchling
description: The dark wings will cloud and consume the minds of the weak, because they are just so adorable!

name: Iron Starlette
description: This massive weapon of destruction has been miniaturized for use in the garden. Moles beware!

name: Weebomination
description: Made from bits and pieces of vanquished battle pets, dark magic, and just a pinch of love.

name: Crazy Carrot
description: Left to their own devices, carrots will simply lose their minds.

name: Mechanical Axebeak
description: Squeeeeeeeawk!

name: Royal Peachick
description: A single peacock feather is often laid upon a grave to ward off evil spirits.

name: Lifelike Mechanical Frostboar
description: After many complaints that taming young boars was a painful experience, engineers came to the rescue with this creepily lifelike model.

name: Teroclaw Hatchling
description: The teroclaw is a potent hunter of the small and furry.

name: Elekk Plushie
description: This adorable little elephant is always there for you.

name: Frostfur Rat
description: Annoying and destructive, they can be coaxed with enough cheese to become a tolerable companion.

name: Autumnal Sproutling
description: From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown.

name: Forest Sproutling
description: From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown.

name: Nightshade Sproutling
description: From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown.

name: Sun Sproutling
description: From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown.

name: Mud Jumper
description: Orcish children have a tradition where they sneak up on a mud jumper and whisper a secret they wish to come true. If the mud jumper doesn't jump, the wish will come true.

name: Ghastly Kid
description: In the ultimate demonstration of stubborness, this once-living nannie simply refused to die.

name: Moonshell Crab
description: The moonshell crab reflects light so well that they can be picked up and used as a mirror. Just keep your face away from the claws!

name: Deathwatch Hatchling
description: This hatchling has an unusual sense that allows it to detect and follow along with alpha predators.

name: Draenei Micro Defender
description: While these tiny mechanical guardians were created to protect domesticated elekks from pests, they also turned out to be really good at giving back massages.

name: Molten Corgi
description: Loves to herd imps, roll around in lava, and snuggle with elemental lords.

name: River Calf
description: Surprisingly quick when provoked, but easily calmed with a meal of Nagrand arrowbloom.

name: Murkidan
description: After consuming the shin bone of Gul'dan, this fiesty demon hunter was caged for 10000 years by his brother Murkfurion.

name: Mossbite Skitterer
description: Camouflaged like moss, the skitterer will hide in trees and leap on their victims from above.

name: Thicket Skitterer
description: Their deceptively cute looks will lure in their prey, and then greet them with a flurry of devastating swipes. Hug with caution.

name: Icespine Hatchling
description: Equipped with extremely sharp claws, these frigid hatchlings dig through thick layers of ice and rock for shelter.

name: Bone Wasp
description: One ogre ritual involves cupping a bone wasp in their hands and shaking vigorously. The venom increases strength and invokes vivid imagery.

name: Bloodsting Wasp
description: Contrary to popular belief, bloodsting wasps do not feed on blood, but love.

name: Wood Wasp
description: Wood wasps make nests in dead or hollowed out trees, and are quick to attack anything that threatens their home.

name: Twilight Wasp
description: In the moonlight their wings create a glittering aura, giving the illusion of twinkling starlight.

name: Amberbarb Wasp
description: Amberbarbs often try to provoke larger creatures to attack it. Once their victim strikes them, they will retaliate with the entire hive.

name: Brightpaw
description: This magical kitty has so much energy that she will sometimes zip around for no reason whatsoever.

name: Sky-Bo
description: The Sky-Bo was originally designed by the infamous Millie Watt as a toy for her cat. The cat just slept in the box next to it.

name: Bloodbeak
description: The ancient tribes of Draenor were known to harvest their sharp beaks for crude tools and weapons.

name: Junglebeak
description: The colorful plumage from these birds are highly sought after by collectors. It is rumored that wearing these feathers will bring you good luck.

name: Axebeak Hatchling
description: The edges of its beak are particularly sharp. Watch your fingers during feeding time!

name: Fruit Hunter
description: This anxious avian has a voracious appetite for fruit.

name: Syd the Squid
description: This tiny squid seems to enjoy wearing pants, but where in the world would you find some that fit?

name: Ore Eater
description: They eat and eat and eat, until they grow large. Then they eat some more.

name: Lovebird Hatchling
description: Of course there are hatchlings, they're called Lovebirds aren't they?

name: Stonegrinder
description: The master-crafted gear assembly and precision joints in this robot are clearly made with love.

name: Bush Chicken
description: Following their introduction to the mainland by the goblins, Bush Chickens have become the entre du jour for Pilgrim's Bounty due to their high deliciousness and low intelligence.

name: Blazing Cindercrawler
description: Tiny, incinerated corpses of various insects line its cage.

name: Stout Alemental
description: The Pandaren Brewmasters accidentally brought a barrel of Uncle Gao's last sentient batch of brew with them to Brewfest.

name: Frostwolf Ghostpup
description: The little wolf told to stay. Watching, waiting, for vacant prey. Too proud to leave, she slipped away. Unburdened now, forever free to play.

name: Ancient Nest Guardian
description: The ancient nest guardian was designed with the unthinkable in mind: to hate cats.

name: Lanticore Spawnling
description: No one knows what deep part of Blackwing Descent the Lanticore was kept in, but it probably smelled pretty awful.

name: Hydraling
description: The hydraling can be an expensive pet, as it is capable of eating from three food bowls at the same time.

name: Frostwolf Pup
description: These pups are bundles of fur and teeth until they grow up, at which point they are really just teeth.

name: Firewing
description: Don't line her cage with paper unless you want a fire.

name: Stormwing
description: Half bird, half elemental, the beautiful Stormwing is truly capable of shock and awe.

name: Doom Bloom
description: A clear indication why goblin fertilizers should be used sparingly.

name: Everbloom Peachick
description: These tiny creatures seem to favor big, fluffy nests, preferably atop an animal-loving dryad.

name: Sentinel's Companion
description: The companion of a night elf sentinel, rarely given out as a gift.

name: Puddle Terror
description: Living so closely to the water's surface, the puddle terror is not only friend to all aquatic creatures, it is one.

name: Soul of the Forge
description: When forging enchanted steel, bits of magic seep into the coals. Over a period of years, decades even, the unbound energy slowly takes form, creating a tiny elemental being of immense fortitude.

name: Albino River Calf
description: Their white hide would make them vulnerable to sunburn, if it wasn't as thick as plate armor.

name: Brilliant Bloodfeather
description: The bloodfeather is completely fearless, fanning out its feathers and charging any threat.

name: Golden Dawnfeather
description: It's said the feathers glitter like gold when the rising sun shines upon them.

name: Son of Sethe
description: Godlike being now in travel size.

name: Eye of Observation
description: You'll always feel like... something is watching you.

name: Bloodthorn Hatchling
description: Ravagers are favored ogre snacks when they are small and less deadly.

name: Frostshell Pincher
description: The frostshell pinchers build up layers of ice to give them the extra protection from larger predators.

name: Ironclaw Scuttler
description: With claws that can crush a platemail gauntlet, it's best to handle with care.

name: Fen Crab
description: These crafty crustaceans burrow under the mud to avoid being scooped up by larger predators.

name: Zangar Crawler
description: They feed off of the nutrient-rich fungal spores which gives these crabs the district coloring of their shells.

name: Kelp Scuttler
description: They will cover themselves in seaweed and other ocean foliage to get the upper claw on their prey.

name: Mudback Calf
description: Surprisingly quick when provoked, but easily calmed with a meal of Nagrand arrowbloom.

name: Flat-Tooth Calf
description: Surprisingly quick when provoked, but easily calmed with a meal of Nagrand arrowbloom.

name: Glowing Sporebat
description: Wild sporebats are vicious creatures, but if tamed at a young age, they can be loyal companions.

name: Shadow Sporebat
description: Wild sporebats are vicious creatures, but if tamed at a young age, they can be loyal companions.

name: Servant of Demidos
description: Demidos created a great many servants when he was hosting parties for other void lords.

name: Grommloc
description: No matter how much he screams, never give him demon blood.

name: Argi
